name: Architecture Designer
detailed_description:

Follow us and our partners at Next Fest!
Don't forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist!


About the Game

ArchitectureDesigner invites you into the world of interior design and home transformation. In this exciting simulation game, you start with a worn-down, abandoned room, filled with dust, broken furniture, and a sense of neglect. Your job is to bring this space back to life, using your creativity and design skills to transform it into a stylish, cozy, and fully functional masterpiece.

🛠️ Engaging Process
The game offers an immersive and hands-on experience that spans from the very first cleaning steps to the final design touches. You'll start by clearing out the debris, fixing broken furniture, and repairing any damage to the walls and floors. Each decision you make during this process is vital as it directly affects the look and feel of the final room. As you progress, you'll tackle more complex tasks such as installing lighting and choosing the perfect furniture to match the overall aesthetic of your design.

🎨 Creative Freedom
One of the core features of ArchitectureDesigner is the creative freedom it offers. Whether you want to go for a modern, minimalist look or a more traditional, cozy vibe, the game allows you to design a space that reflects your unique style. You can experiment with different color schemes, furniture arrangements, and decorative elements to make every room truly one-of-a-kind. The variety of options lets you play around with different themes and approaches to design, ensuring that each project feels fresh and exciting.

💡 Upgrades
As you progress in the game, you’ll earn money and unlock upgrades that help improve the overall atmosphere of the rooms. One of the most important upgrades is lighting. Whether you're going for ambient lighting or statement fixtures, the right lighting can completely transform the feel of a room. With each upgrade, you'll gain access to more sophisticated tools and materials that let you add finer details, enhancing both the aesthetic and functionality of your spaces.

🏡 Designer Furniture
In ArchitectureDesigner, you’ll have access to an exclusive collection of designer furniture. From plush sofas to sleek coffee tables and chic shelving units, these high-quality pieces elevate the design of any room. As you unlock more items, you’ll be able to create even more intricate, sophisticated interiors that showcase your expertise. The goal is to turn every room into a luxurious space with a perfect blend of comfort, style, and functionality.

🔥 Path to Perfection
The game encourages you to turn neglected, forgotten rooms into luxurious, perfectly designed spaces. Every project you take on is an opportunity to showcase your design skills and your ability to transform ordinary spaces into extraordinary ones. From small apartments to larger, more complex rooms, you’ll continue improving your craft and developing your interior design expertise.

ArchitectureDesigner is perfect for anyone who loves design, creativity, and the thrill of transformation. Whether you want to start small with a simple room or challenge yourself with more extensive renovations, the game offers endless possibilities for imaginative design. Get ready to create the space of your dreams and see how far your creativity can take you!

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
